Certain neighborhoods stand out to me for the art and inspiration: the ever-changing graffiti and street art of Kreuzberg; the eclectic RAW-Gelände of Friedrichshain and its projection art museums;[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][vc_column_text]and the organic, community-driven spirit of Neukölln for innovative garden designs. Whether it's Mitte's historical significance or Schlossgarten Charlottenburg's lovely display of topiary, Berlin provides the perfect canvas for creativity. The city offers one of the most unique blend of history, modernity, and artistic expression in all of Europe.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][vc_column][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="120" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_mobile_spacer_size="80" screen_normal_spacer_size="80" screen_tablet_spacer_size="80"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row bg_check="row-background-dark" dfd_bg_style="image" dfd_bg_image_new="15239" dfd_bg_image_repeat="no-repeat" dfd_bg_img_attach="fixed" dfd_overlay_color="#322d26" dfd_overlay_pattern="transperant" dfd_row_config="full_width_content" css=".vc_custom_1722432583555{background-position: center !important;background-repeat: no-repeat !important;background-size: cover !important;}"][vc_column][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="120" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="120" screen_tablet_spacer_size="100" screen_mobile_spacer_size="80"][vc_column_text item_animation="transition.fadeIn"]

Looking to collaborate from

Berlin, JA?

[/vc_column_text][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="40" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="40" screen_tablet_spacer_size="30" screen_mobile_spacer_size="20"][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][vc_column_text]As Oddtoe, a visual artist offering visualization, and design services, Berlin and Germany offer boundless opportunities for artistic collaboration. Oddtoe is dedicated to transforming artistic visions into reality, capturing the essence of Berlin’s diverse cultural tapestry. Inspired by the city's renowned museums, such as the Berlinische Galerie, [/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][vc_column_text]Oddtoe reimagines art and design in innovative ways. Germany has always had a great history of design. In that spirit, Oddtoe is dedicated to turning the creative visions of German companies into physical reality, blending the contemporary influences that make Berlin unique. To embark on a journey of creativity and visual transformation, contact Oddtoe today.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][vc_column][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="120" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="120" screen_tablet_spacer_size="100" screen_mobile_spacer_size="80"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row bg_check="row-background-dark" dfd_enable_overlay="" one_page_title="Type of Client?" anchor="client"][vc_column width="1/4"][/vc_column][vc_column width="1/2"][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="80" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="60" screen_tablet_spacer_size="40" screen_mobile_spacer_size="40"][vc_column_text item_animation="transition.fadeIn"]

[vc_row full_height=”yes” bg_check=”row-background-dark” dfd_bg_style=”canvas” dfd_bg_image_canvas=”13943″ dfd_bg_image_repeat_canvas=”no-repeat” dfd_overlay_color=”#040300″ dfd_overlay_pattern_opacity=”72″ dfd_row_config=”full_width_content” css=”.vc_custom_1720170968283{background-position: center !important;background-repeat: no-repeat !important;background-size: cover !important;}”][vc_column]

Herzliche Willkommen

Berlin, Germany

What I do...

Tourism, Art Projects, Park Design

[vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/4″][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/4″][vc_column_text]As a visual artist specializing in 3D visualization, garden design, and illustration, the grittier areas of Berlin, Germany are an endless source of inspiration. Certain neighborhoods stand out to me for the art and inspiration: the ever-changing graffiti and street art of Kreuzberg; the eclectic RAW-Gelände of Friedrichshain and its projection art museums;[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/4″][vc_column_text]and the organic, community-driven spirit of Neukölln for innovative garden designs. Whether it’s Mitte‘s historical significance or Schlossgarten Charlottenburg‘s lovely display of topiary, Berlin provides the perfect canvas for creativity. The city offers one of the most unique blend of history, modernity, and artistic expression in all of Europe.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/4″][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][vc_column]
[/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row bg_check=”row-background-dark” dfd_bg_style=”image” dfd_bg_image_new=”15239″ dfd_bg_image_repeat=”no-repeat” dfd_bg_img_attach=”fixed” dfd_overlay_color=”#322d26″ dfd_overlay_pattern=”transperant” dfd_row_config=”full_width_content” css=”.vc_custom_1722432583555{background-position: center !important;background-repeat: no-repeat !important;background-size: cover !important;}”][vc_column]
[vc_column_text item_animation=”transition.fadeIn”]

Looking to collaborate from

Berlin, JA?

[/vc_column_text]

[vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/4″][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/4″][vc_column_text]As Oddtoe, a visual artist offering visualization, and design services, Berlin and Germany offer boundless opportunities for artistic collaboration. Oddtoe is dedicated to transforming artistic visions into reality, capturing the essence of Berlin’s diverse cultural tapestry.

Inspired by the city’s renowned museums, such as the Berlinische Galerie, [/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/4″][vc_column_text]Oddtoe reimagines art and design in innovative ways. Germany has always had a great history of design. In that spirit, Oddtoe is dedicated to turning the creative visions of German companies into physical reality, blending the contemporary influences that make Berlin unique.

To embark on a journey of creativity and visual transformation, contact Oddtoe today.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/4″][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][vc_column]

[/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row bg_check=”row-background-dark” dfd_enable_overlay=”” one_page_title=”Type of Client?” anchor=”client”][vc_column width=”1/4″][/vc_column][vc_column width=”1/2″]
[vc_column_text item_animation=”transition.fadeIn”]

Who do you…

See yourself as?

[/vc_column_text]

[dfd_accordion style=”style-3″ active_section=”5″ font_size=”18″ tab_title_google_fonts=”yes” tab_title_custom_fonts=”font_family:Arvo%3Aregular%2Citalic%2C700%2C700italic|font_style:700%20bold%20regular%3A700%3Anormal” icon_size=”18″ icon_color=”#000000″ active_two_px_border=”on”][vc_tta_section i_icon_fontawesome=”fas fa-swatchbook” add_icon=”true” title=”I am an Art Director or Marketing Executive, looking for a creative.” tab_id=”1720739400630-8a1eae4f-0ce23d02-517b”][vc_column_text]

You may be looking for character design, prop design, or any of Oddtoe’s generative AI animation.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section i_icon_fontawesome=”far fa-calendar-alt” add_icon=”true” title=”I am in events management, looking for exciting art for a festival or to activate a space?” tab_id=”1720739324071-d8a71665-ee5b3d02-517b”][vc_column_text]

Then check out Oddtoe’s projection art, installation art, and street art.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section i_icon_fontawesome=”fas fa-city” add_icon=”true” title=”I work in real estate or architecture, asking on behalf of a client.” tab_id=”1720739373559-2d5fa36d-99413d02-517b”][vc_column_text]

Perhaps you’d like to see garden designs or onsite sculpture ideas.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section i_icon_fontawesome=”fas fa-photo-video” add_icon=”true” title=”I am an entertainment producer or a publisher, interested in new content.” tab_id=”1720694349629-5b24d262-795a3d02-517b”][vc_column_text]

Click to Original Stories to see the next generation of content ideas with bots beside me.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section i_icon_fontawesome=”fas fa-palette” add_icon=”true” title=”I work at a gallery or museum, curious about the artwork.” tab_id=”1720695047842-ac5b821a-fb933d02-517b”][vc_column_text]

Go straight to my Portfolio of Work and keep clicking.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][/dfd_accordion]

Contact OddtoeContact Oddtoe
[/vc_column][vc_column width=”1/4″][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row bg_check=”row-background-dark”][vc_column]
[vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/3″][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/3″]
[vc_column_text item_animation=”transition.fadeIn”]

In the market for…

INNOVATIVE DESIGN?

[/vc_column_text]

[vc_column_text]

 As an industrial artist, I wear many hats for many other studios: art director, 3d architect, concept designer, and chief illustrator.

[/vc_column_text]

[vc_column_text]

What are you interested in?

[/vc_column_text]

[/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/3″][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/3″]

Garden Design

Concepts, Visualization, & Plans
[/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/3″]

3D Visualization

Prototyping, Modelling, & Fabrication
[/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/3″]

Visual Content

Illustration, Animation. & Original Stories
[/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner]
[/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row bg_check=”row-background-dark” dfd_overlay_color=”#050228″ dfd_overlay_pattern=”transperant” dfd_overlay_pattern_opacity=”50″ dfd_row_config=”full_width_content” css=”.vc_custom_1722434524181{background: #16141f url(https://www.oddtoe.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/07/Oddtoe-Money-Infamy-About-Me-2-jpeg.webp?id=14784) !important;background-position: center !important;background-repeat: no-repeat !important;background-size: cover !important;}”][vc_column]

[/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row bg_check=”row-background-dark” dfd_enable_overlay=”” one_page_title=”Why” anchor=”Why”][vc_column]
[vc_column_text item_animation=”transition.fadeIn”]

Interested in… 

Park & garden design?

[/vc_column_text]

[vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/3″]
Garden Design
Topiary Design: The Garden Park Project
See a topiarist's vision for a semi-arid topiary garden.
[/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/3″]
Illustration
Visualize!
Visualize anything with this training workshop from Oddtoe & the Datalabs Agency.
[/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/3″]
Animation
Wire Taps TV Show
In the future, our AI bot overlords entertain us with TV soap operas of humanities' conversations, secretly recorded since the Y2K bug.
[/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner]
[/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row bg_check=”row-background-dark” dfd_enable_overlay=”” one_page_title=”Why” anchor=”Why”][vc_column]
[vc_column_text item_animation=”transition.fadeIn”]

Looking for… 

Three-Dimensional Visualization?

[/vc_column_text]

[vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/3″]
3D Modelling
Stained Glass Window Project
A church renovation with a sense of humor.
[/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/3″]
3D Modelling
3D Sculpture Project
Sculpture design case study of Oddtoe's limited edition, "Roman General with Pinkeye".
[/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/3″]
Illustration
Visualize!
Visualize anything with this training workshop from Oddtoe & the Datalabs Agency.
[/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner]
[/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row bg_check=”row-background-dark” dfd_enable_overlay=”” one_page_title=”Why” anchor=”Why”][vc_column]
[vc_column_text item_animation=”transition.fadeIn”]

How about… 

Visual Content?

[/vc_column_text]

[vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/3″]
Comic Art
Gag Cartoonist
The comic panel, Oddtoe, a gag cartoon unique in the world.
[/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/3″]
Animation
The Oddtoe TV Show
See a lost-in-time, satirical newscast from Australia. Shoddy journalism and off-color commercials pepper this modern piss-take of today's media.
[/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/3″]
Comedic Writing
The Jackalope Factory
The calamitous story of the world's most beloved taxidermist is told in this comedic novella.
[/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner]
